feeds.title: Fit French Kiss Blog
feeds.description: Ophelie is an aerial artist, fitness coach, and a true inspiration for anyone looking to break down barriers and achieve their goals. She specializes in applied anatomy and Functional Range Conditioning and provides bespoke and comprehensive coaching to help you get fit, healthy, and pain-free. The blog also shares light on the importance of mental health and how it can help you progress in your career and personal life.

feeds.title: Aerial Physique Blog
feeds.description: Jill Franklin began Aerial Physique back in 2012. She is known for her graceful style in the air. The Aerial Physique Blog is dedicated to making aerial fitness and arts more approachable to curious fitness enthusiasts thereby sharing insightful tips and pointers for aerialists in the form of articles and videos.

feeds.title: Gravotonics Blog
feeds.description: Founded in 2003, Gravotonics began its humble beginnings on the beautiful island of Bali. They aspire to inspire and encourage people worldwide to start aerial yoga to deepen their yoga practice while getting fit and having fun! Read about aerial yoga and yoga swings, as well as yoga tips and general health information for yogis around the world.

feeds.title: Salty Water Yoga Blog
feeds.description: Hi! I'm Pilu. Welcome to Salty Water Yoga, your online Yoga and Aerial Yoga Studio. Dive into my universe by following our free videos, signing up for the courses, or having me guide you through one-on-one classes remotely. Read the blog where you can find information about aerial yoga and yoga in general.

feeds.title: At Om Yoga Blog
feeds.description: AT OM Yoga and Pilates incorporates mindfulness in breath and movement so you can move with ease, think in peace, and radiate light in all aspects of your life. Here we help you become your best self through the methodical practice of aerial yoga. Our blog promotes explanatory articles on the different facets of aerial yoga.

feeds.title: Mindful Child Wellness Blog
feeds.description: Dr. Tracy L. Daniel, the founder of Mindful Child Aerial Yoga and Wellness, has more than 20 years of experience as a psychologist and 5 years in special education administration. She is a trained yoga professional, certified in Hatha, Kundalini, AntiGravity, and children's aerial yoga. She focuses on brain-based movement and behavioral nutritional therapy.

feeds.title: Lauren Kehl Blog
feeds.description: Lauren Kehl encourages people in their aerial fitness quest and shares her expertise on the nuances of aerial fitness by sharing useful articles on taking care of your body, injury recovery, and inversions on her blog.

feeds.title: The Unnata Yoga Journal
feeds.description: The Unnata Yoga Journal explores the fundamentals and philosophy of teaching, technique, and the benefits of modern aerial yoga practice. Through their journal, they explain how Unnata Yoga will expand one's capacity to observe, then release unhelpful patterns for you, like postural misalignment, breath imbalance, and mental stress, and help with mental clarity and calmness.

feeds.title: Ilina Yoga Blog
feeds.description: If you're looking for a traditional, authentic, world-class Yoga learning experience in India, the spiritual center of Yoga and spirituality, then you've come to the right place. Ilina Yoga offers Yoga Alliance USA, Yoga Alliance International Certified 200, 300, 500 Hour Hatha & Ashtanga Yoga Teacher Training Courses (TTC) For Beginners, Intermediate, and Advanced Students.

feeds.title: Fly Freak Studio Blog
feeds.description: Fly Freak Studio is an inclusive, land and air-based fitness community promoting healing through breath and movement. Our blog is your go-to resource to learn more about aerial silks, sling, and lyra, our class formats and their potential benefits, and other happenings at Fly Freak Studio!

feeds.title: Aadi Yoga School Blog
feeds.description: Aadi Yoga School is founded with the confidence to share the traditional experience of yoga & aerial yoga and the intention to lead students along the path of holistic healthy living. Browse the Aadi Yoga School Blog to assimilate more about aerial yoga and help you revitalize your life.

feeds.title: Treeline Aerial Blog
feeds.description: Nestled in the Coast Mountains of British Columbia, we are Treeline. A multidisciplinary studio geared at supporting your strength, wellness, and personal growth journey. We offer classes, online tutorials, special events, and more to get you there. Follow the Treeline Aerial Blog to reflect more on aerial fitness, aerial yoga, and how it aids you in becoming a stronger version of yourself and achieving your true potential.

feeds.title: Aerial Yoga Zone Blog
feeds.description: Aerial Yoga Zone is dedicated to all things related to the wonderful practice of hanging upside down wrapped in a silk hammock! The blog provides a wide selection of articles such as sun salutations in aerial yoga, top aerial yoga books, and also articles that address your health and safety requirements as you practice aerial yoga.

feeds.title: Bend & Fly Blog
feeds.description: Bend + Fly aims to create a joyous experience for its community and help them enjoy the benefits of strength, endurance, flexibility, restoration, and spinal health through aerial yoga training. Their Blog has a collection of posts on aerial yoga including myths around aerial yoga, aerial yoga poses to build strength and core conditioning, and aerial yoga poses to build strength.

feeds.title: Aerial Yoga Teacher Training Blog
feeds.description: Renae, founder of creative body flow has been a pioneer in aerial yoga hammock education for over 10 years. Creative Body Flow emphasizes implementing safe and therapeutic applications of aerial hammocks to help with the physical and mental health of their clients. To understand more about aerial yoga and how to improve your journey as an aerial yoga teacher read their blog.

feeds.title: Lindsay Nova Blog
feeds.description: Lindsay Nova's Blog helps people fall in love with their bodies and discover the beauty of aerial yoga. Along with informative articles on Aerial Yoga, she shares with her readers some personal musings to help summon their inner yogi and start their spiritual journey.

feeds.title: Airo Yoga Blog
feeds.description: Airo Yoga is a fresh, new spin on aerial yoga with a playful and real approach to the traditional teachings of yoga built upon aerial yoga techniques with a custom-designed Airo Yoga swing. It combines elements of Vinyasa Yoga, Pilates, inversions, and Acro-play. Airo Yoga Blog organizes information on Airo Yoga Foundations and benefits of Airo Yoga and updates on their training courses leaving no place for ambiguity.

feeds.title: Sira FLYoga Kids Blog
feeds.description: SiRA FLYoga Blog is an enriching source of meaningful information on the subject of Aerial yoga for kids and the positive impacts it has on them and the author's personal experiences during the teaching process. The blog helps you envision the radiant and serene future that awaits your kid through the practice of aerial yoga.
